name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: UI SDK Drawer parts: a modal sheet from any edge (bottom or side), draggable, with focus trap, Escape and focus restore.
docs: `DrawerContent` returns focus like `DialogContent` (see the Dialog docs): also when the drawer unmounts while open or a field has `autoFocus`; prefer `initialFocus`. Its closing backdrop and content are `pointer-events: none`, but in UI SDK 0.1.0-beta.5 the drawer itself still cancels a press on the page while it slides out, so a click in that moment is lost.
